cert/locks.mjs (homescoop#706, 0.13.1-2): while `uv -vv pip install --no-binary six six` holds the venv's exclusive lock, a second `uv pip install idna` into the same venv logs 'Waiting to acquire exclusive lock for `.venv`' and both succeed, and the venv has six 1.17.0 and idna 3.20; while an install holds the cache's shared lock, `uv cache clean` says 'Cache is currently in-use, waiting for other uv processes to finish', and six still imports afterwards. 0.13.1-1: B doesn't wait (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/stress.mjs (0.13.1-3, homescoop#1287): 6 × uv pip install --no-cache of 41 local wheels (40 × 60 modules and one needing them all) into a fresh venv under SLICC_WASM_BACKTRACE=1: rc 0 and all 40 installed each time, 0 wasm traps, and the wasm memory (VmSize, /proc/<pid>/status) within the 64 MiB initial heap; 0006 (the allocator refresh) and recipe.yaml's wasm.initial-memory

uvx (0.13.1-4, homescoop#771): uvx --version prints uvx and recipe.yaml's version, and uvx --from charset-normalizer normalizer --version prints Charset-Normalizer 3.5.2 from the find-links, with no pypi.org in stderr (homescoop#674's check that the offline config is read); 0.13.1-3 has no uvx command (127)

cert/interrupt.mjs (0.13.1-4): ^C at an interactive bash ends a foreground uv -vv pip install --no-binary six six ($? 130, the next prompt), and a later install into that venv doesn't wait (homescoop#911, a kernel fix: on 1.110.7 uv didn't end); kill -9 of a uv holding the venv's exclusive lock gives 137, and the next uv pip install goes ahead (homescoop#910; engines.slicc-kernel >=1.104.1, slicc-kernel#755)

0.13.1-5: the README's uvx line as written (uvx --from charset-normalizer normalizer file.txt) prints the file's ascii encoding (homescoop#1486; the README said uvx ruff, which ships native wheels only); cert/stress.mjs runs each round detached and polls it, so no harness call nears 120 s under users enforce (homescoop#1489)

homescoop#1541 (cert only; 0.13.1-5 unchanged): checklist.mjs's six sdist build and both locks.mjs races run detached through cert/lib/detached.mjs and are polled, each under a 300 s deadline, and log their rc and seconds; past the deadline the case fails with 'wasi-uv: FAIL <command>: no exit within 300 s', and a nonzero rc still fails its row

cert/timeout.mjs (homescoop#1578, cert only; 0.13.1-5 unchanged): cert/lib/detached.mjs starts each command as a process-group leader (set -m) and on a timeout kills the whole group (kill -9 -- -<pgid>); a hung `uv run --no-project python -c 'time.sleep(600)'` under a 15 s budget fails with 'wasi-uv: FAIL … no exit within 15 s', and afterwards no uv or python process is left in /proc. The helper before this change killed only the wrapper bash, and uv and its python stayed running (NEGATIVE.md); since 0.13.3-1 the log shows that intended timeout as 'timeout: expected, the row hangs uv on purpose: …' rather than as a FAIL line

cert/compile.mjs (0.13.2-1, uv 0.13.2's changes): uv pip compile of requests from the find-links pins requests 2.34.2 and idna 3.20; uv pip compile --python-version 3.14.0.1 exits 2 with 'Invalid version request: 3.14.0.1' (astral-sh/uv#22727) and --format pylock.toml -o / exits 2 with 'Expected the output filename to be `pylock.toml` …; found `/`' (astral-sh/uv#22725), neither a panic; uv export --format pylock.toml writes the project's tool.uv.environments (astral-sh/uv#22596) and that pylock.toml installs idna 3.20; uv pip install -r of a pylock.toml for sys_platform == 'linux' exits 2 with 'The target environment is not supported by the lockfile' and installs nothing (astral-sh/uv#22594); uv pip check -q names its 4 incompatibilities (astral-sh/uv#22544). 0.13.1-5 panics on --python-version and -o / (rc 134, a wasm trap), writes no environments, installs the linux pylock.toml and prints nothing for pip check -q (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/export.mjs (0.13.3-1, homescoop#1920): uv export --extra feature --frozen --no-header --no-annotate --no-hashes of upstream's requirements_txt_does_not_activate_extra_through_incompatible_path fixture (removed from astral-sh/uv's tests between 0.13.2 and 0.13.3; the root needs shared 1 on linux and shared 2 elsewhere, its extra feature adds bridge on linux only, and bridge activates shared's extra a) exits 0 with exactly the lines expected at recipe.yaml's version: uv 0.13.3 and 0.13.4 add leaf-c==1.0.0 ; sys_platform != 'linux', an extra with no compatible activation path (astral-sh/uv#22750 reverted astral-sh/uv#22234's fix for an export slowdown), and from 0.13.5 on (astral-sh/uv#22751 restores the fix) the row expects no leaf-c, as 0.13.2 printed. 0.13.2-1 prints no leaf-c and fails the row at 0.13.3 (NEGATIVE.md)

network: The cert kernel has no network: the spec fetches pinned distributions (sha256-checked) and uv resolves them alone (no-index, find-links in /home/uv.toml via UV_CONFIG_FILE). PyPI over the kernel's CONNECT proxy (TLS with SSL_CERT_FILE) was checked by hand on the Node entry with nodeTransport: uv venv && uv pip install requests && uv run python -c 'import requests' → 2.34.2 /home/u/.venv.
